concept-first.label: C · Concept first
concept-first.about: A vision-language model lists the scene's things and ground cover; SAM 3 finds each of them in every view, the masks are voted onto the splats, and what nobody named comes from a class-free pass.

concept-first-standin.label: C (stand-in) · Concept first
concept-first-standin.about: A stand-in for C: it uses Grounding DINO + SAM 2 in place of SAM 3, whose weights are gated. A vision-language model lists the scene's things and ground cover, Grounding DINO boxes each thing in every view and SAM 2 cuts its mask, the masks are voted onto the splats, and what nobody named comes from a class-free SAM 2 pass.

look.spool: Click the spool: one click should pick the whole spool, flange included. Ground types are under Ground & soil.
look.pumpkin: Click a pumpkin: one click should pick the whole pumpkin. Ground types are under Ground & soil; the hay is wrongly called Moss.
